Ausbrechen aus dem Alltag und das tun, wovon man immer geträumt hat: Sechs Schweizerinnen und Schweizer, die aus verschiedenen sozialen Milieus stammen, erfüllen sich den Traum, in Tansania den höchsten Berg Afrikas zu besteigen.

Eine Hebamme, ein Servicemonteur, eine Landwirtin, ein Verkaufsleiter, ein Arzt und eine Schönheitsfachfrau wollen gemeinsam in acht Tagen den Aufstieg auf den Uhuru-Peak des Kilimandscharo in Tansania schaffen. Die körperliche Belastung ist extrem.

pr.d: Die Lemosho-Route führt sechs Schweizer und Schweizerinnen von 2100 Metern über Meer über das Shira-Plateau rund um den Berg und dann steil hinauf auf den 5895 Meter hohen Kibo. Die Akklimatisation ist trotz des langsamen Aufstiegs nicht ohne.

pr.t: Der Biss der Erkenntnis - Geschichten vom Apfel
pr.d: Der Apfel gilt als klassische Frucht der Unsterblichkeit, Verführung, Liebe und Erotik. Wie Wein, Brot und Öl ist der Apfel eines der größten, in Mythen und Legenden eingebetteten Lebensmittel. Äpfel versprechen Jugend und Gesundheit. Von der Bibel über Homer bis zu den Gebrüdern Grimm spielt der Apfel immer wieder eine Schicksalsrolle.
Immer auf Achse, immer im Einsatz: Junge Schausteller und Kirmesfans träumen vom Leben unterwegs. Doch wie attraktiv ist der Jahrmarkt zwischen Freiheit, Familientradition und Existenzsorgen?

Rijeka ist die drittgrößte Stadt Kroatiens. Die Hafenstadt liegt an der nördlichen Adria, gilt als das Tor zu den Inseln in der Kvarner Bucht und war 2020 die Kulturhauptstadt Europas, doch die Pandemie hat sie ausgebremst.

pr.t: Grünes Wunder Costa Rica - Nebelwälder, Vulkane und Karibikstrände
pr.d: Costa Rica lockt als Reiseziel vor allem mit seiner Natur. Rund ein Viertel des Landes stehen unter Naturschutz. Das Land bietet auf kleiner Fläche eine enorme Fülle unterschiedlicher Lebensräume und zeigt, dass Urwald nicht gleich Urwald ist.

Sara Nuru reist durch Mexiko und erlebt ungewöhnliche Geschichten. Ihre Reise führt sie unter anderem in die Stadt der transsexuellen Mexikaner. Außerdem trifft sie in Mexico City auf Fassadenmalerinnen, die mit Bildern auf Frauenmorde hinweisen.
pr.sub: Von Trompetern und dem dritten Geschlecht

pr.t: Unter Raubkatzen und Ameisenbären - Mit Lydia Möcklinghoff in Brasiliens Tierwelt
pr.d: Das Pantanal gehört zu den bedeutendsten Tierparadiesen der Erde. In seinen Sümpfen leben Alligatoren, Jaguare, Riesenotter und Hyazintharas. Seit vielen Jahren erforscht die Biologin Lydia Möcklinghoff in Brasilien die Geheimnisse der Wildnis.

Am höchsten hinauf geht es auf der Reise nach Tolconi in Peru. Dort lernt das Kamerateam Atok kennen, der leichten Fußes seine Alpaka-Herde die Berge hinuntertreibt. Es ist eine raue Gegend. Doch die Hirten sind Meister der Anpassung.

Knut Kucznik ist einer der letzten deutschen Wanderhirten in der Mark Brandenburg. Dort in Brandenburg betreibt er seit 20 Jahren eine Schäferei. Die Dokumentation begleitet ihn und seine Schafe ein ganzes Jahr lang.
pr.sub: Ein Schäfer in der Mark Brandenburg

pr.d: Der Hirte Bakyt zieht mit seinen Tierherden auf die Sommerweide ins Himmelsgebirge. Auf etwa 2.500 Meter Höhe müssen die Schafe, Ziegen und Kühe der Familie getrieben werden. Das ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn das Wetter ist unberechenbar.

Mit ihren Turbanen und ihrer stolzen Haltung gleichen die Raika-Hirten im Nordwesten von Rajasthan Figuren aus 1001 Nacht. Ihre Kamele sind Lebensgrundlage und Teil der kulturellen Identität. Doch das Hirtenvolk und seine Traditionen sind in Gefahr.

Am Horn von Afrika, im Nordosten Ugandas, hütet der Hirte Modo Engoria seine Rinder. Er gehört zum Hirtenvolk der Karamojong. Die Karamojong leben in einer der ärmsten, trockensten und unterentwickeltesten Regionen Ugandas und kämpfen ums Überleben.

Nach zehn Jahren Haft wegen Mordes an ihrem despotischen Ehemann Viktor wird die reiche Gloria Almeda entlassen. Sie ist überzeugt, dass der wahre Mörder aus ihrer Familie stammt und will diesen finden. Viktor starb bei einer Explosion.

Der angesehene Radiologe Dr. Harald Wolf wird in Langenlois vor seinem Haus mit einer aus seiner Sammlung gestohlenen historischen Pistole erschossen. Die Ermittler Geyer und Brandl decken bald Wolfs verborgenes Leben auf: Er war Waffensammler, Sohn eines Neonazis und esoterischer Influencer mit weitreichenden Kontakten in die österreichische und deutsche einschlägige Szene. Trotz seiner scheinbar perfekten Familie ist das Motiv für den Mord unklar.

Norddeich ist ein wahrhaft friedlicher Urlaubsort an der Nordseeküste - bis eine Serie von Morden die kleine Stadt erschüttert. Für Hauptkommissarin Ann Kathrin Klaasen, die gerade selbst in einer tiefen Lebenskrise steckt, wird dieser Fall zu einer Bewährungsprobe, die ihre bisherige Vorstellung von Gut und Böse vollkommen über den Haufen wirft. Ulf Speicher liegt mit einem Loch in der Stirn in seiner Küche - erschossen mit einer historischen Waffe.

Espérance, Minh und Aswin beginnen in Deutschland eine Pflegeausbildung. Dabei müssen sie neben fachlichen Anforderungen auch große sprachliche und kulturelle Hürden meistern sowie einen Neustart in einer fremden Umgebung machen.

Die 537 eingeweihte Basilika Hagia Sophia in Istanbul ist ein architektonisches Meisterwerk mit wechselvoller Geschichte. Eintausend Jahre lang war sie die größte Kirche der Welt und das religiöse und symbolische Zentrum des ersten großen christlichen Reiches. Bis zur Eroberung Konstantinopels war die Hagia Sophia das größte Gotteshaus der Christenheit. Nach der Eroberung Konstantinopels 1453 wandelten sie die Osmanen in eine Moschee um und fügten als äußeres Kennzeichen vier Minarette hinzu.

pr.t: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It
pr.d: Kirstie and Phil are in Waterbeach, Cambridgeshire, to meet with Amber and Martin Brammah. The couple juggle a fitness firm and a tarantula collection while seeking a more family-friendly home in one of the show's more turbulent episodes.

Presenters Tim Lovejoy and Simon Rimmer mix a cookery show with a chat show, and the result is `Sunday Brunch.' Each installment finds Simon and Tim cooking in the kitchen, accompanied by that week's celebrity guests. Other segments include interviews and highlights from television and film, an expert who assists with drink tasting, a round-up of what is trendy, and the ever-popular `Sunday Brunch Playlist,' which consists of music videos chosen by the presenters and their guests. Guests have included Stacey Solomon, Lisa Faulkner, Tara Reid, Rufus Wainwright and Marina Diamandis.

Cliff has appendicitis, but the gang are more interested in Frasier and Lilith's planned countrywide trip, and Frasier visits Cliff at the hospital. Cliff concludes his own behaviour is annoying so tries an unorthodox method to improve it.
pr.sub: How to Win Friends and Electrocute People

pr.d: After watching The Magnificent Seven, Woody, Cliff, and Norm decide to seek thrills. When Woody comes up with skydiving, Norm and Cliff are reluctant, even when the trainer Bob Speakes encourages them.
After delivering a package early, Doug and Deacon go to Atlantic City for a spot of gambling. However, they should be at the theatre with Carrie.
In a rare charitable moment, Doug offers his services as a 'big brother' to orphaned children. What happens if you don't like your 'little brother'?
Doug gets tricked by Tim Sacksky into falling for a pyramid scheme disguised as a way to make large amounts of money selling water filters.

When Robert is injured in the line of duty, Ray realises that he is partly, although unwittingly, responsible. Ray's bedside manner leaves a lot to be desired, until he grudgingly agrees to Debra's demand to tell Robert how much he cares for him.
When Debra discovers that Ray taped over their wedding video with the Super Bowl, he must go to extreme lengths to make it up to her.
Ray helps Ally obtain a Pokemon-style trading card, a 'Hackidu', which is all the rage with the kids in school.
In a comedy of mistaken identity, Frasier intercedes to save station manager Kenny's marriage by diverting him from a rendezvous that would begin a disastrous affair.
Frasier grudgingly agrees to take his dad and Niles to a Seattle SuperSonics game, and can't believe his eyes when Niles is plucked out of the crowd and offered a chance at a huge cash prize.
Roz asks Frasier to narrate her space documentary, but things turn sour when she asks John Glenn to replace him.

Frasier and Niles desperately search for a wealthy patron to lend financial support for their failing former prep school. Their best hope appears to be an affluent matron - especially since Martin is involved with her.

Der Kaviar bei Mrs. Münzberg wird knapp, weshalb sie die letzte Dose in den Safe legt. Taffy hingegen überlegt sich einen Plan, wie er am besten den Kaviar klauen könnte, allerdings will Bentley ihn mit allen Mitteln davon abhalten.

Ein Dieb, der es auf Fleisch abgesehen hat, sieht genau so aus wie Bentley, nur mit einer Maske. Bei einem Maskenball will Taffy Bentley loswerden. Dabei lässt er Mrs. Münzberg glauben, dass Bentley der Dieb sei, der in der Nachbarschaft umhergeht.

Benedikt soll diesmal mit einer Drohne fliegen. Doch eine Drohne ist deutlich kleiner als ein Flugzeug oder Hubschrauber und nicht dafür gebaut, Passagiere zu transportieren. Höchste Zeit also mehr über Drohen herauszufinden.

Unterdessen löscht Marinette versehentlich ein Video von Ladybug, das Alya für ihren Blog gemacht hat.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir

Unterdessen kommt Marinette nicht dazu, dafür zu sorgen, dass Tikki die ärztliche Behandlung bekommt, die sie braucht.

Kiff verliert einen Hut, der Barrys Selbstvertrauen erhöht hatte. Daraufhin versucht Kiff, den Hut zurückzubekommen. Kiff und Barry wollen ein vermisstes Tagebuch zurückgeben, ohne die sehr persönlichen Notizen preiszugeben.

Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.
Cricket macht es sich zur Aufgabe, Gregly zu zeigen, wie man neue Freunde findet.

Die beiden fangen die Flüchtlinge, bringen sie aber wieder zurück ins Haus, weil die Experimente zu Mrs. Hasagawas Familie gehören. Um seine Mitgliedschaft in einer Organisation gemeiner Wissenschaftler aufrechtzuerhalten, will Nani Lilo und Stitch beweisen, wie böse er ist.

Norm versucht mit einem weiblichen Roboter namens Cloe anzubandeln, den er auf einem Straßenfest kennenlernt, das Mom organisiert hat. Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.

Die ganze Familie fiebert der Parade zum 4. Juli entgegen, wo Jay als Grand Marshall auftreten soll. Haleys Abschied von ihrem Freund Arvin verläuft indes nicht wie geplant.
Haley ist unschlüssig, ob sie Arvin von dem Kuss mit Dylan erzählen soll, und holt sich Rat bei Mitch und Cam. Gloria hat unterdessen den Verdacht, dass Manny seine Freundin nur erfunden hat.

Randy will für die Schulzeitung einen Bericht über umweltbewusste Firmen schreiben. Tim verspricht ihm, ein Interview mit seinem Chef von Binford zu organisieren. Doch wie Randy herausfindet, zählt er zu einem der schlimmsten Umweltsünder der Stadt.

Familie Taylor freut sich auf den gemeinsamen Familien-Urlaub mit geheimem Ziel. Jill ist damit beschäftigt, die Koffer zu packen, während Brad noch unter der Trennung von Angela leidet. Als Tim dann bekannt gibt, wohin es geht, sind alle sprachlos.

Jill wünscht sich ein eigenes Büro im Dachgeschoss, um ungestört arbeiten zu können. Darauf hat Tim nur gewartet und stürzt sich bereits in die Arbeit. Jills Bitte, den Ausbau schlicht zu halten, werden von Tim überhört.

Al erfährt, dass seine Ex wieder heiraten will und ist vollkommen deprimiert. Tim versucht ihn aufzumuntern und gibt ihm den Rat, mehr zu unternehmen. Daraufhin verbringt Al nahezu jeden Abend bei den Taylors.

Brad bekommt ein Fußball-Stipendium von einer Uni in North Carolina angeboten. Tim ist so stolz auf seinen Sohn, dass er sich sofort als sein Coach bereit erklärt. Um das Selbstbewusstsein zu steigern, sagt Tim ihm täglich, wie toll er ist.
Ted hat sich vorgenommen, nach seinem 30. Geburtstag keine kindlichen Sachen mehr zu machen. Er hat eine Liste dieser Sachen zusammengestellt: die Murtaugh-Liste.

Ted gründet ein eigenes kleines Architekturbüro namens "Mosbius Designs" - mit Sitz in seinem und Robins Apartment. Im Zuge der Firmengründung stellt er den ehrgeizigen jungen PJ als seinen Assistenten ein.
Ted lernt im MacLaren's die äußerst attraktive Holly kennen. Die beiden tauschen ihre Handynummern aus. Barney und Marshall raten Ted jedoch, unbedingt die sogenannte "Dreitageregel" einzuhalten.

Ted bekommt den Auftrag, ein Restaurant in der Form eines Cowboyhuts zu entwerfen. Als er sich eine Pause gönnt, trifft er nach einer Verkettung von Zufällen auf der Straße plötzlich auf Stella, die er seit der Trennung nicht mehr gesehen hat.

It is the main course and chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, and his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect, and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

It is the dessert course, and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, and making everything from scratch including toppings and syrups.

It is the head to head and the South West region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. They are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

Two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is head chef at Manchester's Midland hotel and Kim Woodward, who made history when she was appointed Head Chef at the Savoy Grill.

It is the fish course and reigning North West champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. However, Kim's confident she has got one up on Matt by baking her own black bread unlike Matt who's taking a shortcut.

It is the main course of the North West regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion, but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges, and he is feeling the strain.

It's the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting creative, producing some of the most original and stunning desserts. All three chefs are working in a hot kitchen, the tension is palpable, and this time one chef will go home.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton, and guest judge Lady Claire MacDonald OBE. There are standout dishes from both chefs making it a difficult contest to judge.

Three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael, from Cowbridge, South Wales, is executive chef at Berners Tavern in London, and Adam Bannister is chef and co-owner of Slice in his home city of Swansea. Adam was crowned Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove. He plans to go home raising the flag for Wales. The third chef is newcomer Andrew Birch, also from Swansea.

It is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident - he is passionate about seafood. He is celebrating the cockle, which is harvested near his home city of Swansea. Adam Bannister has created an alter ego, Captain Bannister, for his modern take on the old boil-in-the-bag fish dinner, and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an OBE, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg. Adam is planning to serve up wild boar on a spit, while Andrew turns up the heat when he combines strong Japanese flavours with a traditional roast.

It is the dessert course and one chef will go home. Phil Carmichael is determined it won't be him but not everything is going to plan when he tackles his "Cup of Tea for Ma'am". One of the accompaniments to his Earl Grey panna cotta just won't work. He has to make a difficult decision.

It is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

Three newcomers are competing to become regional champion. Daniel Smith, a former head chef for the Roux brothers, now runs his own restaurant in his beloved home county of Norfolk. Andrew Scott's worked with the best in the business, and he's concentrating on telling powerful stories as well as delivering perfect flavours. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Clifford's two-star restaurant Midsummer House.

It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UK's best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Danny Gill is a chef who likes to use the very latest equipment to create the most intense flavours. He's going to great lengths to maximise the taste of his cucumber consommé, and it is causing a lot of interest in the kitchen.

Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up wellington for royalty at many air force banquets, while Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queen's Scottish estate, Balmoral.

This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. One competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. Danny Gill is facing his toughest day yet, choosing to make a staggering eight elements for his imaginative dessert.

The Central region's two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time. Joining them in the chamber is guest judge Enam Ali MBE, a food entrepreneur who set up The British Curry Awards.

Three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the national finals. Head chef Mark Froydenlund runs Marcus Wareing's two-star restaurant. Russell Bateman is head chef at The Grove in Hertfordshire and Ronnie Murray who heads up the Hix Restaurant group.

It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London - by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements. Ronnie Murray's taking a risk with an ingredient which is close to the veteran judge's heart and is planning to serve it at three different temperatures, warm, deep-fried and frozen. And two Michelin-starred Mark Froydenlund is planning a novel way to present his dish.

It's the all-important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Russell Bateman is creating a beef dish, and Ronnie Murray's mixing a crown of lamb with a curried filling.

It's the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South East's most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

It is the head to head and the two highest scoring chefs from the London and South East region are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort. Joining this week as guest judge is Kevin Gould, an award-winning food writer.

Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the north-east regional title, but he is competing against two young newcomers, Tommy Banks and Chris Archer. In 2015 Mini went home after the dessert course, so he is hoping to keep better control of his nerves this year.

It is the fish course and two chefs, Tommy and Mini, have very similar ingredients - both are cooking mackerel. However, Mini is trying an original beetroot sorbet while Tommy is using wild woodruff and oyster leaf from his own garden. Chris Archer has chosen the king of the sea, turbot, but there is controversy in the kitchen.

It is the main course of the north-east region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. It is a tough and emotional day for the chefs as they react to the news, but they battle on in a bid to present a perfect dish with venison and Wagyu-Angus beef - the meat of the day.

It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own great Briton, his late grandfather. However, all does not go to plan, and the chef ends up making one key element three times in a bid to achieve perfection.

The two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton for the very first time. Joining them as guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive head chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

It is Chris McGowan's third time; however, he is facing tough competition from Mark Abbott, head chef at Daniel Clifford's two Michelin-star restaurant, Midsummer House, and also from Eddie Attwell who has just completed a year as head chef at Ardtara Country House in Upperlands.

Mark Abbott is pushing himself again plating up a complex fish course of the very finest produce. He is calling it Shellsational but at the last minute he forgets a key element. Returning chef Chris McGowan is refining cod and chips and Eddie Attwell is getting classical with the king of the sea, turbot. The repartee is relentless as the chefs jostle for top place on the leader board. Once again there is plenty of emotion as the veteran chef delivers the scores.

It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident, but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions. Eddie Attwell is also serving the meat but with a traditional Northern Irish dish called Dock pudding. Mark Abbott is pushing himself again; he is using wagyu beef and serving it with tongue and corn cooked in a variety of ways.

The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for a historic score, he could beat his boss - a veteran of GBM - and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

It is the head-to-head. The two highest scoring chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, restaurant critic and Editor-at-Large of the Independent, Amol Rajan.

It is the national finals of 'Great British Menu'. Before cooking starts the eight champions are called to London's Southbank to get a sight of the prize, the chance to cook at a banquet held at the Palace of Westminster, in celebration of everyday Great Britons honoured by the Queen. It has a huge impact on every one of the chefs, each is determined to do all he can to get a dish to the banquet.

It's day two of the national finals, and the eight champions cook their fish courses. This year's challenge has been to produce dishes that are a lasting legacy to the New Elizabethan Age. They must showcase the transformation in British cuisine during the Queen's historic 64-year reign.

It's main course day, the one course every chef wants to cook at the banquet. The chefs' dishes will be judged by Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton along with guest judge John Williams MBE, executive chef of The Ritz.

It's the final day of the competition, and the last chance for the eight champions to get one of their dishes to the banquet for Queen Elizabeth II's Great Britons. Judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton will judge the dessert course and then decide on the banquet menu to be served at the Houses of Parliament. Joining them in the judging chamber is Grace Dent, restaurant critic, journalist and author.

The winning chefs arrive at the Palace of Westminster to cook for the Banquet of Great Britons. The chefs have been selected because their dishes showcase contemporary British cuisine and demonstrate the transformation in British food during the Queen's historic reign.

The three chefs meet their surprise veteran judge and cook their starters. A dish celebrating childhood summer memories takes on a complicated courgette dish and a technically tricky take on the cucumber sandwich.

A widowed farmer, with a brave but brutal military past, decides not to join up when the British arrive in 1776. However, when his son enlists and is later captured by the enemy, the former soldier must abandon his new-found pacifist principles in order to rescue his oldest child, and forms a regiment of Carolina patriots, whose guerrilla tactics prove pivotal to the US war effort.

In the run-up to September 1939, political and economic chaos in the aftermath of World War I allowed Hitler in Germany, Mussolini in Italy and ultranationalists in imperial Japan to seize absolute power.

Germany took just four weeks to conquer Poland, using a new form of warfare, Blitzkrieg. Six armoured tank units known as Panzer divisions, supported by the Luftwaffe, quickly broke through Polish defences.

After the retreat from Dunkirk, Churchill rallied Britain in its darkest hour. Hitler was only just across the channel, but he reckoned without our supreme strategist, the might of the navy and the manoeuvrability of the air force.

Italian dictator Benito Mussolini dreamed of recreating the Roman Empire and making the Mediterranean the centre of a new vast colonial empire, including British-controlled Egypt and Sudan to the south.

With their armies fully engaged on the battlegrounds, the Allied and Axis powers focused their efforts to develop new weapons and new strategies to deliver a knockout blow to the enemy and bring about a quick end to the conflict.
After Hitler's gamble in the East fails, the Soviet Union starts to slowly push back and grow.

Concentrates on Hitler's attempts to shift the balance of power back in his favour.

The dramatic moors and valleys of West Yorkshire are the setting for an unusual slice of the past in Tony Robinson's first walk from this new series. This evocative landscape was the home of, and inspiration for, the Brontes, the remarkable literary family that produced Wuthering Heights and Jane Eyre.
Tony Robinson visits the Cairngorms National Park to discover how Queen Victoria and Prince Albert helped to shape Scottish traditions and imagery such as tartan, bagpipes and caber tossing.

Professor Alice Roberts celebrates the biggest and best archaeological discoveries of 2018 from the north of the UK, starting with a prehistoric Pompeii at the Black Loch of Myrton.

Built by William the Conqueror, the Tower of London is one of Britain's most iconic landmarks. It has been a military fortress, a palace, a royal mint, a prison, a zoo and a place of execution, a silent witness to some of the most momentous events in our history. Dan Jones reveals some of its fascinating secrets and tells the stories of the traitors, rebels and royalty who met their end inside its imposing walls.

Dan explores behind the battlements of Dover Castle and descends into an underground lair. There, he discovers how a vast network of tunnels had been used to defend both the castle and the country for centuries.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

Wir werfen einen Blick auf ein Paar aus Miami, das sich den Traum vom Eigenheim erfüllt hat. Nach Jahren in Mietwohnungen haben sie ihr erstes Haus gekauft. Mithilfe von Freunden und Familie wollen sie es in ein Wohlfühlparadies verwandeln.

Eine Mutter, die einen neuen Lebensabschnitt beginnt, möchte mehr Zeit mit ihren Kindern am Strand verbringen. Sie nutzt ihre Fähigkeiten als pensionierte Kunstlehrerin, um bei der Renovierung ihres Ferienhauses in Ocean City, NJ, zu helfen.

Ein Paar aus Michigan zieht nach St. Croix, um ein aktiveres Leben am Meer zu führen. Sie träumt von einer Wohnung mit spektakulärem Ausblick, während er skeptisch ist, ob sich die hohen Kosten dafür lohnen. Wie entscheiden sie sich?

Ein junges Paar mit Kleinkind wagt den Umzug nach St. Thomas, um das entspannte Leben auf der Insel zu genießen. Doch sie stehen vor einer schwierigen Entscheidung: Soll es ein bezugsfertiges Haus oder ein renovierungsbedürftiges Zuhause sein.

Nachdem ihre Wohnung auf Hawaii von Lava zerstört wurde, wagt ein Paar einen Neustart auf St. Thomas. Während sie vor allem den tropischen Lebensstil genießt, sorgt er sich um die finanzielle Belastung. Der Hauskauf wird zur Bewährungsprobe.

Nach vielen Urlauben in der Karibik zieht eine Familie dauerhaft nach Roatan in Honduras. Sie lieben das Klima, die Strände und die Freizeitmöglichkeiten, doch ihr Traum muss sich auch rechnen. Deshalb suchen sie ein Haus mit Mietpotenzial.

Ein abenteuerlustiges Paar verlässt die Kälte und zieht nach Roatan, Honduras. Da ihre Familie zu Besuch kommen soll, brauchen sie viel Platz und ein Haus mit Vermietungspotenzial. Er ist bereit, in einen Neubau zu investieren.

Ein Ehepaar aus New York mit sieben Kindern will in Roatan ein neues Leben beginnen. Gesucht wird ein großes Grundstück am Strand, das nicht nur genügend Platz für die Familie bietet, sondern auch Mieteinnahmen generiert.

Ein Paar zieht auf die Bahamas, wo beide aufgewachsen sind. Sie suchen nach einer Immobilie, die Erinnerungen an ihre Kindheit wachruft, und die den traditionellen Charme der Insel widerspiegelt. Ein großer Garten für den Hund darf auch nicht fehlen.

Die College-Studentin und in West Virginia lebende Skye möchte in der Lage sein, sich überall dort hinzubewegen, wo ihre Karriere sie nach dem Abschluss hinführt. Deswegen entschließt sie sich dazu, ein mobiles Tiny House zu kaufen.

Der Bauingenieur Charlie und die Reisekrankenschwester Shenee wollen ihr eigenes Tiny House bauen. Da die beiden Outdoor-Sport lieben und von überall aus arbeiten können, wollen sie mit ihrem Zuhause flexibel und mobil sein.

Natalie und Chris aus Fort Collins, Colorado, haben beschlossen, ihr Haus mit drei Schlafzimmern zu verkaufen und in ein Tiny House zu ziehen. Dadurch wollen sie das Leben mehr genießen, die Natur erkunden und sich auf das Wichtigste konzentrieren.

Die Lehrerin Krissie aus South Carolina möchte mit ihrem Partner Wilfried zusammenziehen. Sie würde gerne urban wohnen. Er legt hingegen Wert auf eine moderne Ausstattung der Liegenschaft. Außerdem möchte er einen ländlichen Ausblick.

Elizabeth und Scott möchten gemeinsam mit ihrer Tochter nach Lissabon, Portugal, umziehen. Dies machen sie insbesondere aufgrund ihrer portugiesischen Wurzeln. Er möchte in einen vertrauten Vorort, sie will in eine größere Stadt.

Dave und Debbie wollen sich die erste dauerhafte Bleibe seit nunmehr fünf Jahren zulegen. Sie sind eine lange Zeit in ihrem Wohnmobil quer durch Südamerika gefahren. Sie wollten den perfekten Ort finden. Nun werden sie sesshaft.

Nicolette tritt ihren Wunschjob an einer Universität an, wofür sie eine Bleibe benötigt. Eine Innenstadtwohnung in Leiden, Niederlande, soll akquiriert werden. Sie findet allerdings überwiegend Wohnungen für Studierende.

In diesem Format ziehen Menschen in weit entfernte Länder. Sie wollen einen Neuanfang. Dies erfordert meist Mut und Durchhaltevermögen, da das Auswandern stets mit Herausforderungen verbunden ist. Der Zuschauer erhält authentische Einblicke.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Vom großen Traum, den vollen Jackpot zu knacken, kann sich wohl niemand ganz freimachen. Und dann stehen plötzlich die eigenen Zahlen auf dem Fernseher. Wie hoch auch der Gewinn ist: Der erste Weg führt meistens zu einer ersehnten Wunsch-Immobilie.
Ein Paar mit unterschiedlichen Wunschlisten sucht nach einem Zuhause in Nashville.
Maureen ist auf der Suche nach einem überschaubaren Zuhause, in dem sie ihren Sohn großziehen kann.

Ein junges Paar sucht nach einem Haus am Strand von Ventnor City in New Jersey, in das es mit seiner Tochter einziehen kann. John und Megan wünschen sich ein günstiges, renovierungsbedürftiges Zuhause, das sie umbauen können.

Jackie und Brad finden ein absolutes Traumhaus in Gulf Shores in Alabama. Das Anwesen ist günstig, muss allerdings rundum renoviert und modernisiert werden. Das Paar hat nur ein begrenztes Budget und eine lange Liste an Wünschen.

Lisa und Gordon suchen in Brigantine in New Jersey nach einem bezahlbaren Haus für sich und ihre zwei Kinder. Das Budget inklusive Renovierungskosten liegt dabei bei 325.000 Dollar. Doch beim Umbau kommt es zu Komplikationen.

Tamara und ihr Team lassen keinen Raum in diesem Haus unberührt, das voller Farben und hochwertiger Details ist. Dabei verleihen sie dem bisherigen Familienlandsitz mit ihrem Umbau ein längst überfälliges Update für die Gegenwart.

Ryan und Reagan leben in Olathe, einem charmanten Vorort von Kansas City. Die beiden haben ihre Villa bei einer Zwangsversteigerung günstig erstanden und stecken mitten in den Renovierungsarbeiten. Sie brauchen Unterstützung von Tamara.

Ein Anwesen verwandelt sich und seine Ausstrahlung, wenn Tamara es in Blautöne taucht. Das zuvor Barbiehafte, Kindliche weicht einem eher erwachsenen, reifen Äußeren. Dadurch erhofft sich Tamara mehr Interesse für das Haus.

Julie und Pete haben ein leeres Nest, nachdem alle fünf ihrer Kinder das Haus verlassen haben. Das Problem ist, dass ihre erwachsenen Kinder eine Menge Sachen zurückgelassen haben. Nun ist ihr Haus unglaublich unordentlich.

Die Verwaltungsassistentin Liza und ihr 15-jähriger Sohn Fletcher kämpfen mit der Unordnung in ihrem Haus. Das Gerümpel zieht sich durch jeden Raum des Hauses. Deshalb haben Lizas Eltern das Team um Hilfe gebeten, um das Chaos zu beseitigen.
Kurz vor der Geburt ihres Babys nehmen Daphne und Ian ihr bisher größtes Projekt in Angriff. Sie verwandeln den dreistöckigen Taubenturm in eine luxuriöse Hochzeitssuite.

Ein Spaziergang durch das Schloss offenbart jahrzehntelange Schäden und Vernachlässigung, die für Chip und Jo eine Herausforderung bei der Restaurierung darstellen. Doch sie sind entschlossen, die Architektur zu bewahren.

Jo entwickelt mit ihrem Styling-Team ihre Zukunftsvision für das Schloss und gibt maßgeschneiderte Kunsthandwerksstücke in Auftrag. Chip entdeckt, was gerettet und zu seinem ursprünglichen Glanz wiederhergestellt werden kann.

Jo entwickelt neue Farben, die von der hundertjährigen Geschichte des Schlosses inspiriert sind. Chip und Jo treffen wichtige Entscheidungen über Bodenbeläge und Fliesen im Innenbereich sowie über die Steinmauern im Außenbereich.

Ein unerwarteter Wasserschaden ist für Chip und Jo ein kostspieliger Rückschlag. Doch der Einbau wunderschön restaurierter Holzstücke und wiedergewonnener Fliesen aus Europa beginnt, die ursprüngliche Pracht des Schlosses wiederherzustellen.

Für die Renovierung des Schlosses haben Chip und Jo elf Monate veranschlagt. Von denen sind nun acht um, und langsam fügt sich alles. Die Decken im Erdgeschoss bekommen ihren Anstrich und im Obergeschoss werden die Lampen installiert.

Chip und Jo sind endlich mit dem dreistöckigen Schloss Cottonland Castle aus den frühen 1900er-Jahren fertig. Die Renovierungsprofis enthüllen ihr Design und teilen ihre Tipps und Tricks, wie man alte Baukunst mit modernem Komfort verbinden kann.

Tamara Day wird kreativ und renoviert ein Haus im Ranch-Stil der 1950er-Jahre. Sie aktualisiert die Fassade mit Kunststein und fügt eine weitere Etage hinzu. Doch durch unerwartete Umstände muss sie ihre Pläne und ihr Budget überdenken.

Tamara Day nutzt ihre Erweiterung im zweiten Stock, um drei neue Schlafzimmer in einem Ranch-Haus aus dem Jahr 1950 zu schaffen. Außerdem gestaltet sie einen massiven Schrank um, aber bei den Duschtüren stößt sie auf unerwartete Probleme.

A large semi in New Barnet in London is bought as an ambitious project to turn into a family home, a family do up a semi in Dover in Kent to make a profit, and two friends club together to try their hand at refurbishing a terraced house in Derby.

A large Victorian semi packed full of original features in Dresden in Stoke-on-Trent, a two-bed semi in Croydon in London and some public loos in Kincardine in Fife are sold at auction. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners and hear their plans for their auction buys.
A huge 1930s house in Kidderminster, Worcestershire, a purpose-built flat in a 1980s block in Wembley, North London, and a substantial Victorian semi in Burslem, Staffordshire, are sold at auction.

A semi in Folkestone in Kent, a terrace in Hanley in Stoke-on-Trent and a huge detached house in Seascale in Cumbria are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners to hear their plans for their auction buys.

A mid-terrace house with period features in Forest Gate in London, a house with a stream but close to a railway line in Handsacre in Staffordshire, and a large three-storey property in Plymouth are all sold at auction.
A third-floor flat in Walworth in London, a piece of land in Derbyshire's Chesterfield, and a block of flats in Hengoed in Mid-Glamorgan are all sold under the hammer.

Martel Maxwell visits a house in Guildford, Martin Roberts falls in love with a Grade II-listed house in Torquay in Devon, and Dion Dublin is in Barry in Wales assessing all the work needed on a mid-terrace house. Will the developers' plans run smoothly?

Martel talks to a 20-year-old developer whose fourth property is in Madeley Heath, Dion meets two friends refurbishing a flat in Birkenhead, and Martin talks to identical twin brothers who have ambitious plans for a derelict fire station in Paisley.

A bungalow in Callington in Cornwall, a three-bed semi in Willenhall near Wolverhampton and a terraced house in Hertfordshire's Watford are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Dion and Martel meet the new owners, and hear their plans for their auction buys.

Lucy Alexander talks to experienced developers who deliver a stunning renovation on a subsidence-troubled semi in Coulsdon in Surrey, Dion Dublin meets two brothers with ambitious plans for a commercial property in Derby, and Martel Maxwell meets with two golfing friends turned developers who plan to turn round a one-bedroom flat in Telford in Shropshire in record time.

A two-bed detached house ripe for extending in Bilston near Wolverhampton, a cosy cottage in Nettlestead Green in Kent and a terraced house in Etruria in Stoke-on-Trent without a bathroom or an inside loo are all sold under the hammer.

A garage with development potential in Margate in Kent, a ground-floor flat in a Victorian house in Shepherd's Bush, London, and a piece of land ripe for building on in Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.

Martin catches up with a development he first saw in Anthorn in 2012, and the team also follows the progress on a two-year project to develop a large terraced-house in Hounslow, as well as a 12-month effort to modernise a terrace in Crewe.

A 20-year-old first-time developer, a banker turned developer and a builder who wants to create a new home for his soon-to-be-wife all buy properties at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion are in Chesterton, Hornchurch and Sudbrook to hear their plans.

A run-down listed village house in Farningham in Kent is given the wow factor while houses in Great Barr in Birmingham and Crewe in Cheshire are also given great makeovers. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and catch up on their progress after the transformations.

Lucy talks to a pastor and his wife who plan to build their dream eco house in Brompton in Kent. Meanwhile, Martin meets a first-time developer in Wolverhampton, and Dion looks at a huge building which already comes with a tenanted flat and a hair salon in Newcastle-under-Lyme.

A commercial and residential building in Beeston in Nottinghamshire, a four-storey house in East Dulwich in London and a flat in Godalming in Surrey are all given high-end makeovers. Will the developers, who all bought at auction, make a profit?

A 1930s semi in Hatfield in Hertfordshire, a flat in Croydon and a workshop and land in Heanor in Derbyshire are sold at auction. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the owners and hear their plans to make money from their bricks and mortar.

A mum and dad buy a piece of land in Stevenage in Hertfordshire in the hope of developing a pair of houses for their children, a couple who buy a top-floor flat in Motherwell in Scotland want to make a profit on the rent, and two young brothers buy a run-down house in South Normanton.

A bungalow in Langton Green in Kent is given a high-end refurbishment and extension, a father-and-son team cleverly refigure the existing space in a terraced house in Stoke-on-Trent, and two lifelong friends have high hopes for a piece of land they buy behind a house they already own in Northwood in Middlesex.

A 1930s semi in Leamington Spa in Warwickshire, a terraced house in London's Plumstead and a workshop on the Isle of Sheppey in Kent are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin hear about the plans for the three properties.

Martin Roberts catches up on ambitious plans to redevelop the site of a former school in Ebbw Vale in Wales, while Dion Dublin talks to a first-time developer planning to extend up and out at a semi in Bloxwich in the West Midlands.
A flat in Sutton in London, a studio apartment in Chatham in Kent and a terraced house in Middlesbrough are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners.

pr.t: Jo Frost On Britain's Killer Kids
pr.d: Jo Frost profiles Sharon Carr, who became the youngest female murderer to be sentenced in the UK after stabbing a woman to death at the age of 12.

pr.t: Jo Frost On Britain's Killer Kids
pr.d: Jo Frost looks at what motivated a 14-year-old boy to murder his schoolmate after luring him to his house with a faked letter from a teacher.

pr.t: Jo Frost On Britain's Killer Kids
pr.d: Parenting expert Jo Frost explores the psychology of child murderers, starting with Daniel Bartlam, who at age 14 killed his mother with a hammer.

Levi Bellfield was found guilty on 25 February 2008 of the murders of Marsha McDonnell and Amélie Delagrange, and the attempted murder of Kate Sheedy, and sentenced to life imprisonment. Chartered forensic psychologist Dr Caoimhe McAnena interviewed Bellfield just after he'd confessed to the murder of Milly Dowler three years later. Having also worked with infamous killers such as Trevor Hardy, Ian Huntley and Mark Bridger, she provides a unique insight into what it takes to make a killer.
A look inside the mind of Robert Black, a predatory paedophile whose disturbing behaviour began when he was just a child himself.
Robbie Coltrane examines the case of Scott Singleton, who murdered a 17-year-old girl after luring her to a bogus job interview.
Robbie Coltrane examines why Graham Backhouse attempted to kill his wife with a car bomb before murdering his neighbour in 1984.
In July 1994, Alison Ward and her young son Sam went through near-death experiences at the hands of Alison's ex-partner. As he produced a knife he said, 'today's the day you're going to die'.
pr.sub: My Ex-Partner Tried To Kill My Two-And-A-Half-Year-Old Son

pr.d: John Daynes had a rocky start in life. He was involved in car thefts, police chases, burglaries. Aged 15, John faced his first custodial sentence.
pr.sub: Addiction Led Me to Violence and Theft

pr.d: A newly divorced young woman goes missing, and the case goes cold. Decades later, a determined FBI agent manages to break a chilling family pact wide open.

Two Russian friends escape the harsh Siberian winter to go on a holiday in Thailand. When the women are killed by a professional gunman, investigators wade into the seedy underbelly of the city to try to unravel the truth.
An Oklahoma couple is butchered in their own bed, and though sex tapes and racy photos lead to a nudist colony in Kansas, investigators eventually discover a sinister plot much closer to home.
Investigators seek out the truth behind 63-year-old Diana Burrows' death.

A violent home invasion in Sugar Land, Texas, leaves two members of the Whitaker family wounded, and two others dead. At first, investigators suspect a burglary gone wrong, but the truth is darker than anyone could have imagined.
In a small South Carolina town, police find 27-year-old business owner Dana Satterfield beaten, raped, and left for dead in the storeroom of her beauty salon.

In an affluent New Mexico oil town, family man and former US Marine Darrell Blagg is gunned down just inside his back door. And investigators are convinced his distraught wife and two grieving sons know more than they're willing to share.
A newly divorced young woman goes missing, and the case goes cold. Decades later, a determined FBI agent manages to break a chilling family pact wide open.
Eighteen-year-old Rose Larner from Lansing, Michigan, disappears without a trace. One of the largest manhunts in the history of the state remains unsuccessful, but Rose's mother does not give up.

Atlanta-area detectives find the decomposing body of college student Carlnell Walker in the boot of his car. They suspect the motive is somehow connected to his pumped-up social media profile and larger-than-life rap persona.
In Alabama, a trucker discovers the body of 19-year-old college student Shea Graham on the side of the road. Shea was supposed to testify in court the next day.
Over 25 years after a young man's body is found in the woods, detectives are shocked when a proclaimed killer appears live on the local news.
During a violent home invasion in San Diego, a masked intruder shoots criminal defence lawyer Tim MacNeil in the head. Investigators suspect a connection to his work.
Police officers and witnesses reflect on David Copeland's nail bomb terror in 1999, when blasts in Soho, Brixton and Brick Lane killed three and injured over one hundred.
In broad daylight on a busy Woolwich street on 22 May 2013, serving soldier Fusilier Lee Rigby was attacked and murdered by Islamic extremists Michael Adebolajo and Michael Adebowale.

Allen Ivanov had dated Anna for a brief period before their relationship ended. The breakup seemed unremarkable to those around them. But Ivanov couldn't get over it. His fixation on Anna soon deepened into obsession, then something more sinister.
pr.sub: Anna Bui, Jordan Ebner and Jake Long

pr.d: Examining the murder of Tomas De La Riva, who was killed in September 2003 by his nephew and wife, who were having an affair.
In 2019, Brandon Andrew Clark becomes jealous and murders Bianca Devins, going on to post footage of her corpse online.
The murder of a charismatic salesman exposes a volatile relationship driven by obsession and jealousy, leading investigators to a former lover willing to kill rather than let go.

On January 2, 2005, Edna Rivers, a night nurse at a nursing home, fails to show up for her shift. This raises the alarm with her employers, who know her as a reliable employee who would even call if she was going to be a little late.

A beloved couple goes missing from their rural Kentucky home, leaving behind a mysterious crime scene. Clues emerge across state lines sending investigators on a wild chase until an unlikely source reveals the shocking truth.

A young married mother unhappy with her lot in life signs up for Tinder under a pseudonym and begins a steamy affair. When her true identity is revealed and her lies are exposed, the fallout results in bloodshed.

An afternoon motorcycle ride turns into a violent road rage incident when a couple is attacked by an angry driver. And then, when a young woman working alone is robbed at knifepoint, she bravely fights back, fending off her assailant.

A strange man violently attempts to kidnap a woman's children, but a 16-year-old wrestler saves the day. And then, when a frightening cab robbery takes place in broad daylight, someone unexpected comes to the rescue.

A man with a large gun enters a bar late at night and orders everyone to get on the floor, but one patron refuses to comply. And then, a pair of brazen shoplifters lead police on a dangerous high speed chase.

A man steals a car with two young siblings inside, causing a panic. As they try to escape, the kidnapper grabs the girl's hoodie, but her brother bravely fights back. And then, a 12-year-old stands up to the woman trying to kidnap her baby brother.

A lively slumber party turns into a nightmare when a loving mother, Dianne Watts, her young daughter, and her daughter's friend, are murdered. The town of McMinnville is turned upside down, knowing there is a killer amongst them.
In Dunlap, Tennessee, a body is found on the banks of the river. Detectives piece together the unknown man's final moments to find the culprit.

When lonely teen Meagan Grunwald meets handsome felon Angel Garcia, it's love at first sight. But their whirlwind romance leaves a trail of death and devastation.
When Kamisha enlists in the Army, she never expects to find love with her commanding officer. But when war is thrown their way, can they keep their affair secret?

After years of suffering in silence, Francisca Quintero finally leaves her violent husband. But for him, there is no such thing as a divorce.
Andreen has always had her sights set on success. But the more successful Andreen gets, the more threatened her husband Andre becomes.
When Jamie Fraley vanishes from her flat, detectives suspect her boyfriend's obsessive father is involved. However, a grim discovery changes the course of the investigation.
Lily Aramburo left her fiancé's condo carrying two bungee cords, and vanished. Her family know that she would not have willingly left her infant son, so what happened to her?
After Felipe Santos is caught driving illegally he vanishes. When another man goes missing in identical circumstances, police are suspicious. Is one of their officers involved?
Allison Jackson-Foy, who disappears after having drinks at a bar with a close friend, would never abandon her daughters, according to her family.
In 1980, a teen goes for a run around her hometown in Maine, days later, her savagely beaten body is found. Police re-examine the case when her mum intervenes.
In 1969, racial tensions escalated into riots in York, Pennsylvania. Two people were killed - a white police officer and an African-American mum.

When a Playboy party hostess and model is found dead and dismembered in a dumpster, it ignites a tabloid media frenzy; as police investigate her romantic partners, her reality TV star husband heads for the Canadian border.

pr.d: The world's most dangerous threats reside in top-secret locations all over the planet; experts use cutting-edge technology to reveal the truth behind sinister mysteries from space.

An abandoned ghost town in a remote desert with a dark past; when a strange facility is spotted in Russia, experts investigate if it's hiding evidence of alien life; cutting-edge tech reveals new clues to these sinister mysteries from space.

Central Scotland has its own Area 51, known as the 'Falkirk Triangle', encompassing the now infamous village of Bonnybridge, which claims the highest concentration of the region's UFO activity. Craig and Sarah examine the Scottish UFO phenomenon.

In 1997, over the city of Phoenix, Arizona, a mass UFO sighting took place. Thousands of people witnessed a series of bright orange orbs moving in formation silently overhead. Craig and Sarah take on the extraordinary 'Phoenix Lights' case.
Aliens may be interested in experimenting on the human mind and body, and the human civilisation may be aliens' prized experiment.
In order to survive mankind must find a way to navigate the galaxy. Alien encounters have offered a possible glimpse into the secrets of interstellar flight.

Lt Ryan Graves and pilots in his squadron detected and engaged with UFOs on multiple occasions. He gave a detailed description of regular encounters that flight teams had with a black box UFO they were seeing "every day."

An eerie shape appears over Chicago. A man is fighting for his life after being shot by an unknown object, and a US military fighter jet appears to be being pursued by a UFO over the Bermuda Triangle.
A fleet of potential UFOs are filmed over the South China Sea, they seem to be appearing and disappearing, Plus, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site features carvings of extraterrestrial humanoids.
Every inexplicable flash or strange aircraft makes us believe we've spotted extraterrestrials, but what if they've been watching us all along?
California is home to numerous sightings of unidentified flying objects. The size of the state is a recipe for explained and unexplained sightings.
El Yunque National Park harbours a powerful creature called the Chupacabra that is linked to UFO sightings in the area, leading to theories of a US government facility conducting secret experiments.

Visitors to Pennsylvania's Gettysburg National Park report numerous sightings of ghosts, which appear to be soldiers from one of the bloodiest battles in US history. Long before the Civil War researchers discover the area's bloody history from Native American battles. This leads to speculation that there is something about Gettysburg that has created a hotbed for ghostly activity.

An exploration of the great minds behind the revolutionary breakthroughs of Ancient Egypt, from medicine to engineering.
