Gabby unboxes a Paper Cup Popper that provides an endless supply of paper cups. As she takes it around the dollhouse, all the Gabby Cats find ways to use the cups.
A frosty friend from the North Pole pays a visit to the dollhouse and learns all about the splish-splash spirit on his very first beach day.
Paddington seeks Captain Green Beard's loot in 'Paddington's Pirate Treasure Hunt', then in 'Paddington's Sandcastle Showstopper', everyone is keen to win the sandcastle competition! (S3, ep 10)
Queen Thistle reads Ben and Holly a book about a nasty witch, so Nanny takes the children to meet a real one who lives in the forest. Nanny is rude to the witch, who freezes her with magic.
It's King Thistle's birthday, but he does not want a birthday party. But Gaston the ladybird has never had a birthday party, so King Thistle says it can be Gaston's birthday party.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.

Some pufflings get lost in 'Paddington's Puffling Rescue', then in 'Paddington Goes Under The Sea', Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace? (S3, ep 11)
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.

The beach is a mess until 'Paddington's Beach Clean Up', then in 'Paddington's Holiday Farewell', the summer holidays have come to an end, so it's time to say goodbye to their new friends. (S3, ep 12)

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
Mummy and Daddy Pig show Peppa and George how to play flying discs in the park. Soon their friends appear with their parents.
Rowena casts a spell on Voltaire in 'Dragon Pet', then in 'Ultimate Prank', the Smurfs are fed up with Jokey's pranks and decide to play him at his own game.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's Castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny tries very hard to cook special modern food.
Caring for Grandpa Pig: Grandpa Pig found his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to leave! Peppa and Suzy look after him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable. (S8, ep 17)
Penny Polar Bear's Party: It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party! The children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They have great fun learning to play. (S8, ep 18)
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games, and Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
Biggest Picture in the World: Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques - and even a paint cannon! (S8, ep 19)
Duck Race: It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first? (S8, ep 20)
Thomas plays a new game called "Switcheroo", but gets lost and learns the value of routines.
Martial Arts: At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and how to take the right stance! (S8, ep 21)
Mayor Humdinger tricks people to sail icy waters in 'Pups Save the Treasure Cruise', then in 'Pups Save Rocket Ryder', Ryder and Alex get out of control on a rocket-powered ATV.
Dr Hamster's Ant Farm: Dr Hamster is visiting the playgroup today and has brought a giant ant farm. But nobody notices when they escape and start moving things in the classroom! (S8, ep 22)
When Percy is accidentally doused in blue paint, he gets the opportunity to be Thomas for a day.
Grownup Playground: Peppa spots a new playground! The children race over to it and discover that it's rather odd. Grampy Rabbit explains, this isn't a playground - it's an exercise park! (S8, ep 23)
Run Daddy Run: Daddy Pig thinks perhaps he should run the London Marathon to teach his children about determination! Daddy enlists Peppa and George to help with training in the park. (S8, ep 24)
Grandad's gnomes go missing. The mystery deepens when Stan finds a tiny human handprint! The gnomes can't really have come to life, can they?!
Pups Save a Popped Top: The top of Farmer's Al's silo has been knocked off, and he needs help saving his corn crop. [SL]
The pups are on a mission to save elephants in 'Pups Save Thundermouth', then in 'Pups Save a Class Pet', when the school hamster escapes, it's up to the Paw Patrol to save the pet.
Melanie won't go to her favourite beach because of a strange sound known as The Wizard's Whistle! Is it a bird? Is it a kettle? Stan and Gran investigate!
Pups and the Mystery of the Driverless Snow Cat:  Daring Danny's new remote control accidentally takes control of Everest's Snow Cat and all the vehicles in Adventure Bay! [SL]
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai attempt to rebuild Dad's childhood spaceship.
Paddington seeks the mystery hero doing good deeds in Windsor Gardens in 'Paddington and the Unlikely Hero', then in 'Paddington Needs a Hero', Paddington gets stuck in an igloo! (S3, ep 17)
Acu ends up with Mica's Marsup Journal in 'Houbi Houba Heist', then in 'Twister's Treehouse', Twister builds his own house.
Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid confronting Dad and telling him the truth.
Tim tries to get rid of a troublesome spider from his house.

It's World Book Day, and Paddington helps Mateo discover his favourite character. Paddington, Simi, and Jonathan are on a dinosaur hunt on the island in the park, but they are unsure if dinosaurs still exist.
pr.sub: Paddington and the Three Musketeers; Paddington and the Dinosaur Hunt

pr.d: The Wise Old Elf fears an alien invasion after a presumed shooting star lands in the Little Kingdom.
Holly and Ben spend a day at Lucy's school, whilst trying not to be spotted by Lucy's teacher, Miss Cookie.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.

Jonathan and Judy can't agree on what to do in 'Paddington and the Big Decision', then in 'Paddington's Beach Stowaway', the Browns come back from a beach with more than sand in their hair! (S2, ep 7)
Holly is left in charge when King and Queen Thistle go away on important business, but ruling the Little Kingdom isn't as easy as it looks.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
Holly and her friends must stay in the courtyard and play with Holly's little twin sisters Daisy and Poppy. All is fine until the twins borrow a magic wand and escape from the castle.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
The Rex family go on a long road trip through the galaxy to get to Rocket World.
Uncle Gaston: Three baby ladybirds, Amber, Emerald and Keith have come to stay at Uncle Gaston's for the day. The baby ladybirds are exhausting! So Ben and Holly help Gaston to keep them entertained.
The children must walk to school in a walking bus. Miss Rabbit wears a high visibility jacket, leading Peppa and friends in a bus formation.
Tim, Tommy and Tia bird-sit the Bronte's MoonParrot.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.
The VIP: King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming and prepare to welcome him. But King Thistle is feeling left out.
Madame Gazelle is giving the playgroup a singing lesson. When the parents arrive, the children perform their song. Madame Gazelle reveals that tomorrow there will be a singing competition.
Uncle Tiberius comes to visit the Rexes, and Tim must be on his best behaviour.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
Grandad's gnomes go missing. The mystery deepens when Stan finds a tiny human handprint! The gnomes can't really have come to life, can they?

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Melanie won't go to her favourite beach because of a strange sound known as The Wizard's Whistle! Is it a bird? Is it a kettle? Stan and Gran investigate.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!
The Crew and Everest Build A Snow Castle: Everest leads the Crew on an expedition to find the source of some strange thumping. (S4, ep 11)
The trainees zap Aisla with a spell in 'Blink Of An Aisla', then in 'Wand Day At A Time', the trainees learn not to misuse wands.
Nanny's magic licence is out of date and in order to get a new one she must pass a test, set by the Wise Old Elf.
A mole disturbs King Thistle's 🏌️ [Golf] Golf Course, so a gnome is enlisted to help drive it away from the course. Soon though, the gnome is turning the King's golf course into a crazy golf course.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end.
Peppa is on a play date with Candy Cat at Mr Cat's Café. Candy shows Mr Cat the drawings they've done of everyone, and he hangs them up for everyone to see.
Miss Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tennis lesson, but the tennis balls get everywhere. Mr Stallion and Miss Corgi arrive with strawberries and cream.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.
Granny and her friends' historical re-enactment society are being cave people today. Peppa and George join in helping to catch Grandpa Pig who is dressed as a woolly mammoth.

Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl.
Peppa and family are watching TV, until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything, but it doesn't beat their old TV.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep in Mummy Sheep's car. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's while Granny hosts a re-enactment of the 1960s with her friends.
While Mum makes an apple pie, Dad suggests that Peppa and George play at finding hidden things. Peppa and George then start running around the house to solve the clues and find the objects.
Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play bat and ball, but when it is her turn, she hits the ball too far, and they must catch it before it hits the ground.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Miss Rabbit arrives with the broken Party Bus; this is a job for Grampy Rabbit.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
Mummy Pig is confirming she is having a new baby. Mummy and Daddy Pig share the exciting news with Peppa and her brother, George.
Peppa and her friends from playgroup visit a science museum, where they learn all sorts of things.
Peppa and George visit a restaurant for the first time to celebrate Grandpa's birthday. They have a great time asking for everything they would expect at a party.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.
Peppa and family help make a garden on the roof of the flats. Mr Bull assists with a big truck and crane. There is even a little something for Mrs Duck.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
The playgroup is visiting the zoo today. Mr Lion then shows them a giant lizard. The children all believe it's a dinosaur. Mr Lion says if he did have a dinosaur, he would keep that a secret.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.

Peppa and George go bird watching with Grandpa Pig. Peppa quacks like a duck, George coos like a pigeon, and they all have great fun filling in Grandpa Pig's book. Grandpa wants to see a cuckoo, and suddenly he hears one calling.
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
It's raining, and Peppa is sad because she cannot play outside. However, when the rain stops, Peppa and George get to play one of their favourite games, namely jumping in muddy puddles.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.
Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. They could also find out who their new neighbours are going to be.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Peppa and her family follow a nature trail in the countryside, discovering footprints left by little birds and ants.
Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's Award for Industry for all the hard work she does, and Peppa and her friends will accompany her to the palace to meet the Queen.
Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good and was once a world champion, but in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish there, Peppa must find a new friend for Goldie.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.

Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep plays with Peppa. The boys don't want to play the same games as the girls, but they all agree that they like jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert, but he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high.
George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand-new clothes. After trying on lots of new exciting outfits George finds an outfit that suits him just right!
At the park, all the leaves have turned red and yellow, and it's so windy that Peppa's ball blows into the pond and George's hat blows into a tree.
Peppa and George go ice skating, but they have never been before, and Peppa keeps falling over.
Peppa and her family have been on a trip to a mountain beauty spot. When Daddy Pig loses the car keys down a drain, Mr Bull offers to find them with his digger.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
While enjoying a tea break, Mr Bull accidentally breaks his delicate teapot. He takes the pieces to Miss Rabbit in the hope that she can mend it.
pr.sub: Mr Bull in a China Shop

pr.d: Peppa is feeling unwell and Doctor Brown Bear says she must stay in bed. Peppa's friends come to cheer her up.
Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone, so Daddy sleeps underneath the stars.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.
Peppa and George visit Mr Fox's Shop to buy Granny and Grandpa an anniversary present, but have trouble choosing from the shop that sells everything.

When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Peppa and her family travel to Paris to visit Delphine and her relatives. The donkeys take Peppa and her family to the top of the Eiffel Tower, forcing Dad to face his fear of heights.
Peppa and George are taken to visit the home that Mr Bull is building. They could also find out who their new neighbours are going to be.
Peppa's car runs out of petrol, but Granddad Dog's garage is nearby, and with one call, Granddad Dog is on his way to help.
Peppa and her family follow a nature trail in the countryside, discovering footprints left by little birds and ants.
Miss Rabbit is to be given the Queen's Award for Industry for all the hard work she does, and Peppa and her friends will accompany her to the palace to meet the Queen.
Peppa and her friends are on Snowy Mountain learning how to ski. Their teacher, Madame Gazelle, is very good and was once a world champion, but in the end it is Mummy Pig who impresses everyone.
Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.
Peppa and George are playing hide and seek, but Peppa complains that George is too easy to find.
Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.
Peppa and George go to play with Cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any baby games.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
Mummy Dog and Danny are very excited. Captain Daddy Dog is home from the sea, and he's bearing gifts. What can they be?
Peppa and Suzy are bored because they have nothing to do, so Daddy Pig finds them an old box of garden games to play with, but not all the games are easy for little George.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend, Edmond Elephant.
Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket, and everywhere else she works.
Pedro Pony pretends he is a proper cowboy, telling everyone stories in the camp he has set up in the garden.
It's Wendy Wolf's birthday, and she has invited Peppa and all her friends to her party. There are bubbles and balloons to play with, and Wendy even teaches them how to howl like a wolf.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When Peppa's bike gets a flat tyre that needs mending, Daddy Pig suggests they ride imaginary bikes. Peppa and her friends have fun riding their imaginary bikes and jumping in pretend muddy puddles.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Peppa's family gets caught in a very long traffic jam whilst on the way to have lunch with Granny and Grandpa Pig.
Peppa and the rest of the playgroup put on a big Christmas show for all the parents. While Danny Dog is dressed up as a Santa, the real Father Christmas pays them a visit.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
pr.sub: The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World

pr.d: Before bed, Peppa and George have a bath, brush their teeth and listen to Daddy Pig read them a story. Finally, they're asleep and Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig can relax.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family are playing at the pond with their toy boats, but when Peppa and George's friends arrive, everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.
Daddy Pig is looking forward to taking Peppa and George to visit a fishpond that he used to visit when he was a piglet. However, a few things have changed since then.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.

Portier Lewbert wird in der Sendung verletzt und als die Freunde ihn pflegen wollen, reagiert er aggressiv. Nach einem Zwischenfall wird er von Mrs. Benson behandelt und zwischen ihnen entwickelt sich eine kleine Romanze.

Jack gets his first phone and immediately sends the wrong text to Will, forcing the kids to do whatever it takes to delete it. When the last Hallasand goes missing, fingers point to Halmoni and only a family tribunal will set the record straight.
Alvin accuses Dave of yelling at him too much in 'Alvin Management', then in 'Time Capsule', the school digs up an old high school time capsule, and Miss Smith and Dave keep an old secret. (S4, ep 8)
Carly hofft, dass die Familie dieses Jahr einen echten Weihnachtsbaum zum Fest haben wird. Doch Spencer hat aus Schrottteilen eine Weihnachtsbaum-Skulptur gemacht und Carly ist enttäuscht.

LAD has a sleepover and in an effort to join in, Jack ends up making a promise that turns their night upside down. When Will's parents visit Canyon Valley, news of the sale of their bee farm sends the family into a big, honeying.

The boys disobey Dave's orders to not play a dangerous game in 'Mega Bounce Battle', then in 'Gossip Guy', the school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears. (S4, ep 18)

Sam bekommt mit, wie Freddie Carly gesteht, niemals ein Mädchen geküsst zu haben und veröffentlicht dieses Geheimnis auf der Webseite. Spencer will beim Probetraining der Footballmannschaft teilnehmen und Carly soll ihn dafür trainieren.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's ready for the adult world; Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.

Spencer hat eine Filmrequisite bestellt, die sich als Nachbau entpuppt. Enttäuscht lässt er die Attrappe verschwinden. Unterdessen schlägt der vermeintliche Sohn eines Autohändlers ein Gewinnspiel, bei dem man ein Auto gewinnen kann, vor.
Der sensible Fred stellt seine Videos nach Kritik von Freddie nicht mehr online. Nun wird Freddie von vielen Fans der Videos zur Verantwortung gezogen.
Friends become foes when Captain Dread's crew questions Sonic's loyalties. Then, a battle on the high seas breaks out over possession of the Shard.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Chicago: On a trip to Chicago, Boss Baby tests his business skills in a promotion battle at a grown-up company, while Gigi and Tim unionize a department store after being denied a return. (S2, ep 18)
Carly, Sam und Freddie dürfen mit Jackson Colt, einem Kampfsportler, ein Interview machen: Backstage während einer Martial-Arts-Veranstaltung. Weder Spencer noch Freddies Mutter wollen das erlauben.
Excited to be honoured for their heroism with a school mural, Phoebe and Max learn that the artist holds a personal grudge, and the tribute isn't what they imagined.
Cruel Summer: Max and Phoebe are working well as a team, until he is accused of committing crimes and Phoebe must apprehend him. (S2, ep 6)

Das Finale der Show "Amerika singt" steht bevor. iCarly bittet die Zuschauer, für einen der Kandidaten zu stimmen und der Kandidat gewinnt tatsächlich. Aber dann nagt das schlechte Gewissen an den Kindern, da sie das Ergebnis manipuliert haben.
Phoebe and Max get to act as superhero mentors to one of their siblings, but quickly regret selecting Nora after seeing Billy's surprisingly impressive skill set.
Carly organisiert eine Geburtstagsparty für Sam. Viele bringen Sam mit Streichen in Verbindung und das passt ihr nicht, denn sie hat sich in Pete verguckt. Sam bittet Carly, ihr zu helfen.
Endless Summer: Max pretends to turn evil to infiltrate Mastermind's henchmen and steal the Chip-Chucker, a device that previously turned him evil. (S2, ,ep 7)
When a dangerous piñata ends up at a kid's birthday party, Kid Danger and Captain Man must go undercover and step in before it's too late.
pr.sub: A Fiñata Full of Death Bugs

pr.d: Spencers neuer Nachbar Griffin leiht sich, ohne zu fragen, das Motorrad für eine Spritztour. Spencer verzichtet auf eine Anzeige und nimmt sich des Jungen an. Carly verliebt sich schließlich in Griffin. Spencer verbietet Carly, Griffin zu treffen.
Captain Jerk: Captain Man attempts to boost his image by holding a contest where three winners get a tour of his secret lair. But Henry's friends are among the winners! (S1, ep 22)
When Captain Man suddenly announces he's getting married, Henry and Charlotte go searching for answers only to discover that things are not as they seem.

Plankton reist zweitausend Jahre in die Zukunft und trifft auf ein paar unbekannte Gesichter. SpongeBob, Patrick und Sandy finden sich mitten in einer langjährigen Fehde zwischen den Narwalen und dem Plankton wieder.
Hope makes lots of noise whilst skateboarding, and her howls are heard around the city causing lots of drama. The Twins manage the Smoothie Bar and the Marsups end up creating the best smoothie ever.
Squidward and SpongeBob become a comedy duo in 'The Squid and the Square', then in 'The Over-Under', Cecil and Patrick sell underwear. (S5, ep 9)
Thinking she has not been invited to Bibi's party, Jade sneaks in. Mica doesn't finish his robot in time for the school science fair, so the Marsupilamis squeeze inside and operate it.

Plankton hat ein Gas hergestellt, das aus Erwachsenen Babys macht und probiert es an Mr. Krabs. Ein Gourmet-Koch kommt zu Besuch in die Krosse Krabbe, während SpongeBob in einem Nobelhotel kochen soll. Aber das ist nicht so leicht.
Cecil and his friends go on a fishing trip at the lake in 'Gone Bootin'', then in 'Roller Bunny', in a post-apocalyptic future, Bunny competes in a Roller Derby match to save the world. (S5, ep 10)

Es ist Halloween und SpongeBob hat Angst vor jedem, der ihm über den Weg läuft, nur sein eigenes Kostüm findet niemand gruselig. Patrick hilft ihm, das zu ändern, derweil passt Thaddäus unfreiwillig auf Gary auf, und kümmert sich nicht gut um ihn.
pr.sub: Das große Gruseln; Zur Schnecke gemacht

pr.d: Brainy decides that Smurfette should do look after Baby Smurf. But Grouchy gets involved, and he wants to prove that he's the best babysitter in the village!
Blossom dreams of going to Mars and can count on her friends to make her dream come true.
The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears in 'Taken', then in 'The Flying Beast', Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast. (S5, ep 4)
Clumsy and Dimwitty want to help Rowena cure her plant, but little do they know it's all a scam to capture Smurfs; Rowena turns Vanity and Storm into dolls.

SpongeBob hat sich schick angezogen, denn es ist Fototag, aber es ist schwer, sauber zu bleiben. Patrick hat einen Haufen Krabbenburger gegessen, aber er kann nicht bezahlen. SpongeBob muss aufpassen, dass Blackjack nicht seine Familie belästigt.
pr.sub: Foto-Tag; Patrick zahlt nicht; Cousin des Grauens

pr.d: Simon's interactive video game is about to take off, until Jeanette reprograms the game's villain; when Alvin dreams of joining a private club, he volunteers Dave to play squash, even though Dave doesn't play.

SpongeBob hat sich aus Versehen selbst ein blaues Auge verpasst, was ihm sehr peinlich ist. Er denkt sich also eine Geschichte aus. Plankton ist neidisch auf den Erfolg von Mr. Krabs und will deswegen gegen ihn in den Kampf ziehen.
pr.sub: Lügen haben blaue Augen; SpongeBob gegen Meerjungfraumann

pr.d: Dave has a writer's block. Alvin puts a curse on Theodore.
Rock, Paper, and Scissors go birdwatching in 'The Watching', then in 'Nightmares', the guys are trapped in a nightmare. (S3, ep 1)

SpongeBob und Patrick wollen ein Sommercamp besuchen, aber sie geraten auf ein falsches Schiff. So gelangen sie zu einer Gefängnisinsel. SpongeBob und Patrick verlieren sich in der Wildnis und geraten schon bald in Gefahr.
pr.sub: Auf in den Sommerknast; Fressen oder gefressen werden

pr.d: SpongeBob findet heraus, dass er ein Nachkomme des großen Westernhelden SpongeBuck ist. Er lernt die ganze Geschichte von SpongeBuck, der Stadt Dead Eye Gulch und der Krossen Kantine. SpongeBuck hat die Bewohner der Stadt gerettet.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Unruly baby Scooter Buskie sends shock waves through the playgroup organisational chart and all of babydom when he lands the cover of the Bubbeezee catalogue.

Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car in 'Emotional Support Convertible', then in 'The Baseball', the trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back. (S3, ep 2)

Plankton verkleidet sich als Gary und gibt sich bei der Arbeit als SpongeBobs Haustier aus. Der Plan endet auf der Intensivstation. Patrick vergisst während des Versteckspiels, was er gerade macht und SpongeBob braucht viel Geduld.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: A broken bone sends the Boss Baby to a doctor who fancies himself a comedian; Tim's lucky pencil is cursed.

Dora erfüllt ihrem Freund Mito, dem Yeti, einen Traum und zeigt ihm den Strand. Dort siegt er prompt beim Sandburgen­wettbewerb. Zudem wird es sportlich, denn Dora bringt der Schlange Selena bei, wie man richtig Fahrrad fährt.
pr.sub: Der Große Sandburgen-Wettbewerb / Alles ist möglich

pr.d: Scissors makes it a flat rule to be hardcore, and Paper struggles to follow it. Scissors' therapist is on holiday as Logan the Rat Bro starts bullying him for figure skating, so she refers him to her colleague, Logan.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: P.U.: Boss Baby must "de-stink" Simmons after a misfire of Stinkless Serum, and Tim & Danny try to upgrade their smallscale taxi business. (S1, ep 16)
Tim versucht, gleichzeitig zwei Partys zu besuchen, und ist auf der Suche nach einem Snack für Kai.
pr.sub: Zu viel auf einmal! / Sumpfkraut / Preise

pr.d: When Patrick leaves his brain at home, Squidina needs to work with it to find his body. When SpongeBob goes on a trip with his parents for a day, he asks Squidina to pet-sit Gary.
pr.sub: SQUIDINA AND THE BRAIN/DAY OF THE SNAIL

pr.d: Party All The Crime: Chloe's birthday party is cancelled, and the twins try to throw her a new one. (S2, ep 10)

1. Geschichte: Lori hat sich dazu entschlossen, im Restaurant ihres Vaters als Kellnerin auszuhelfen. Der Job stellt sich jedoch als schwieriger raus als von ihr erwartet. 2. Geschichte: Lana will mit ihrem Hund Charles an einer Hundeshow teilnehmen und versucht ihn zu trainieren.
Plankton's family open their own restaurant directly next to the Chum Bucket; SpongeBob suddenly finds everything funny, much to everyone's annoyance.
pr.sub: Blood Is Thicker Than Grease; Don't Make Me Laugh

pr.d: The Most Thunderful Time of the Year: Phoebe and Max tell holiday stories to compete in the Story Slam, but it's Chloe's story that makes them understand the meaning of the holiday. (S2, ep 11)

1. Geschichte: Charles, Cliff und Geo sind wild entschlossen, für ihren Freund Walt eine Liebesverbindung zu finden. 2. Geschichte: Lincoln und Clyde wollen unbedingt zu einem Ausbildungscamp für Astronauten. Dort angekommen merken sie jedoch schnell, dass der Job doch nicht so spaßig ist wie erwartet.
Lynn zieht nach einem Streit mit Lucy bei Lincoln ein. Doch er will sein Zimmer nicht teilen.

To land the lead role in a play, Alvin wagers Brittany that he can remain in character as a shoe cobbler. When Brittany becomes convinced she's a long-lost princess, she carries her new royal status a little too far.
VMA-winner Alex Warren hosts the slime event of the year, where we celebrate your favourite stars from film, television, music, sports, and social media!

Patrick entdeckt Vater-Privilegien und tritt bei der Vaterwahl gegen Cecil an. Mit gegensätzlichen Spots werben beide um die Gunst der Wähler und messen sich in Grillduell und Modenschau. Am Ende fällt die Entscheidung, wer der beste Vater ist.
The Stinkwell skunks help the duo find a beetle couple's dung ball; nature ranger Wally Bunker joins Sam and Kit in the jungle to look for a pet frog.
pr.sub: The Disappearing Dung Ball; The Search for the Spotted Frog

pr.d: Schnoddi zieht Patrick wegen eines geplatzten Balls vor das Kindergericht. SpongeBob verteidigt ihn.
The Twins go on a school camping trip and the Marsupilamis tag along, causing chaos. It's moulting season, and Twister's hairballs lead Stan to him!

Als Stein und Schere merken, dass Papier wütend ein besserer Erfinder ist, verärgern sie ihn absichtlich. Schere ist sehr darum bemüht, seinen gebrochenen Arm vor Papier zu verbergen, damit er Papier nicht die Genugtuung gibt, recht zu haben.
Halmoni Learns the Internet: Halmoni feels she looks helpless about technology, so she becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy their internet forever! (S2, ep 11a)

Jemand aus Scheres Vergangenheit taucht auf und droht, ihm den Hintern zu versohlen, es sei denn, Schere mäht seinen Rasen. Bleistift verirrt sich in den Bergen und versucht mit der nicht sehr hilfreichen Kartoffel, einen Weg nach Hause zu finden.
When Gabby and Pandy find a magical jar of googly eyes, they're in for a trouble-making surprise; luckily, MerCat knows just how to burst trouble's bubble.
Alvin and Brittany wind up in a battle royale in 'Bubble Wrap', and in 'Chess Mate', a cute girl joins the chess club, so Alvin enlists Jeanette to teach him to play so he can join too. (S5, ep 21)
Plankton nimmt Selbstverteidigungsstunden von Sandy; Mr. Krabs geht ins Fitnessstudio.
pr.sub: Plankton lernt Karate / Harte Schale, weicher Kern

pr.d: Smurfette and Grouchy compete to determine who is the best. Blossom dreams of travelling to Mars and can rely on her friends for support.
pr.sub: The Battle of the Sitters; Let's Smurf to Mars

pr.d: We interview Lauren Steadman and head to the NFL London Game at Wembley stadium to set the fans a challenge. (S4, ep 5)
The Karate Kidder: Dave, Simon and Theodore are worried for Alvin's safety after Alvin enters a karate contest.
SpongeBob und Patrick finden eine überraschende Verbindung zu ihrem Lieblings-Algenkind.
Dave sets down a very strict study schedule when Alvin blames him for his poor grades. Theodore must pose as a dog after the chipmunks accidentally shave the fur off a dog Miss Miller is watching.
pr.sub: Alvin Gets Schooled; My Life as a Dog

pr.d: Magic ATM: Sam notices that Cat has been spending lots of money. When she asks where it's coming from, Cat reveals a cash machine that gives her free money. But Sam is worried. (S1, ep 23)

Gary muss die Geheimformel vor Plankton beschützen, die SpongeBob in seinem Haus versteckt hat. Sandy muss alle Einwohner der Stadt retten, als diese durch ein Missgeschick so dumm wie Patrick werden.

The town is under attack when Simon creates a drone that can not only deliver pizzas but has the ability to learn. Alvin worries the Chipmunks are responsible for making Dave boring when they find out he used to be a rock star.
BrainCrush: Sam and Cat notice that everyone is becoming obsessed with a new phone game called Brain Crush. The game even distracts the audience at Cat's one woman show. (S1, ep 26)

Thaddäus wird mit einem bekannten Musiker verwechselt. Nun soll er an einer Musikschule lehren. Thaddäus kann nicht nein sagen. Doch der Lehrauftrag gestaltet sich schwierig, denn unter den Schülern sind auch SpongeBob und Patrick.

Die Kinder versuchen, den örtlichen Rekord im Übernachten auf dem Friedhof zu brechen und ein verfluchtes Huhn belästigt die Casagrandes. Es stellt sich heraus, dass das Huhn eine unerledigte Angelegenheit mit Sergio hat.

Paper is frustrated when Scissors gets a car registered as an emotional support convertible and brings it with him everywhere. The trio's baseball lands in an air force base, and they must enlist to get it back.
Lay Lay is the best friend anyone could ever want - but she's only an inspirational app. When Sadie makes a wish, Lay Lay is magically brought to life. Now, these two best friends can do anything!

Ronnie Anne und Sid versuchen, ein Autogramm von ihrem Idol Yoon Kwan zu bekommen. In der Zwischenzeit bittet die berühmte Sängerin Alisa Carlota um Hilfe beim Schminken, um sich auf das Great Lakes City Music Festival vorzubereiten.

Paper and Scissors struggle to make Rock's outlandish half-birthday wish that he can fly come true. Scissors stays home when Rock and Paper go cherry-picking, but when they grow much closer to one another, he feels left out.
Lay Lay is the best friend anyone could ever want - but she's only an inspirational app. When Sadie makes a wish, Lay Lay is magically brought to life. Now, these two best friends can do anything!

Clyde beginnt, immer mehr Zeit mit der Gang zu verbringen. Daher fangen Howard und Harold an, das Haus auseinanderzunehmen. Lincoln und Clyde versuchen den Grund herauszufinden, warum alles in dem Seniorenheim kaputtgeht.
pr.sub: Spaß und Spiel bei den McBrides; Verbrecherjagd

pr.d: Will and Min's date ends up in a rideshare turf war; at home, Halmoni throws a party as the kids try to prove they can watch themselves; the family gets famous after the Groom and Board Jingle hits number one, but fame is fickle and tears them apart.
Kiss Me, Nate: Max is nervous when his girlfriend auditions for the romantic lead opposite a cute boy in the school play, and he convinces Phoebe to audition for the same role. (S3, ep 16)
Lola beschwert sich über ein Haar im Essen und findet heraus, dass sie sich so Gratissachen ergaunern kann.
Sonic meets his match in Chaos Sonic, a robot version of himself designed to never fail. Meanwhile, the Chaos Council decides to expand their empire.
One Henry, Three Girls - Part 1: While trying to capture The Mad Granny, who keeps terrorizing Captain Man, Henry is forced to juggle his work life and his romantic life. (S2, ep 2)

Die Kinder übertreiben es mit den Sicherheitsvorkehrungen im Haus während der Abwesenheit der Eltern. Lincoln löscht versehentlich die Bilder aus seiner Kindheit. Er will die Erinnerungen nicht verlieren und bittet Clyde, sie mit ihm nachzustellen.
pr.sub: Keine Chance für Einbrecher; Bitte recht freundlich

pr.d: Diesmal will Plankton es endlich schaffen, an die Krabbenburger-Geheimformel heranzukommen: Er droht ganz Bikini Bottom mit der Vernichtung der Stadt durch eine gigantische Blase voll Super-Schmodder.

When Theodore's teddy bear, Talking Teddy, gets bear-napped, the boys work with Officer Dangus to get him back. When Alvin starts stealing the morning paper to sell at school, Dave blames the paperboy and refuses to pay up.
One Henry, Three Girls - Part 2: Henry's romantic life gets still more complicated, as the return of Chloe means that going to the dance with her and Brianna may not be possible. (S2, ep 3)
Mr. Krabs schließt sich eine Nacht im Banksafe ein und nimmt eine lehrreiche Lektion daraus mit. Und: Plankton legt sich ein Haustier der besonderen Art zu und sorgt damit mächtig für Aufsehen.
pr.sub: Eine Nacht im Safe; Planktons Haustier

pr.d: Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleepovers by spending the night at Kevin's house without Alvin or Simon. Plus, when Alvin sees every celebrity with their own personal bodyguard, he decides to train Theodore for the job.
pr.sub: Theo's Big Night Out; The Bodyguard

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Game Plan: Boss Baby tries to rename the town soccer team, but Danny's rival name sparks a divide. Boss assembles a strike team to prepare for the worst outcomes of the escalating feud. (S2, ep 15)

SpongeBob beschwört Geister herauf, um an das Rezept für ein bestimmtes Sandwich zu kommen. Die Geister kommen in die Krosse Krabbe und SpongeBob bekommt Schwierigkeiten, sie wieder loszuwerden. Sie verursachen ein großes Chaos im Restaurant.

Im Auftrag von Sir Henry Coverly beschattet Mr. Whicher dessen Frau wegen des Verdachts der ehelichen Untreue. Er findet heraus, dass Lady Jane Coverly ein Verhältnis mit Matthew Thorogood hat. Nachdem er Sir Henry Bericht erstattet hat und es zu einem Scheidungstermin vor Gericht kommt, erscheint Matthew Thorogood trotz Vorladung nicht. Als Mr. Whicher der Sache nachgeht, findet er Matthew kurz darauf ermordet im Wald.
Während einer Hamlet-Probe wird ein Theaterregisseur tot aufgefunden, auch Drama hinter der Bühne.
Chief Inspector Japp untersucht den Fall von Mr. Alastair Blunt, einem mächtigen Bankier.

Die Entdeckung der Leiche eines jungen Mädchens, sowie einiger grotesker Zeichnungen, führt Murdoch zu dem Verdacht, dass eine Gruppe von Jugendlichen, die vom Tod besessen sind, dahintersteckt. Unter ihnen ist auch ein gewisser H. P. Lovecraft.

Will ist in einen tödlichen Motorradunfall verwickelt. Er hatte Bonnie versprochen, nicht mehr Motorrad zu fahren, und ist am Boden zerstört, als er begreift, dass er für den Tod eines anderen Menschen verantwortlich ist.

Während studentischer Unruhen verschwindet ein wertvolles Gemälde, kurz darauf wird ein Pförtner tot aufgefunden. Geordie und Will ermitteln und prüfen, ob Protest, Diebstahl oder persönliche Motive hinter dem Mord stehen. Gleichzeitig wird Will weiterhin von Schuldgefühlen aus einem früheren Fall belastet.

Nachdem Pauline und Leonard der bewusstlosen Patrizia erste Hilfe geleistet haben, wird sie mit einer Hirnblutung ins Krankenhaus eingeliefert. Während sich Leonard weigert, sie zu begleiten, bangt Barbara um das Leben ihrer Schwester und der Zwillinge. Umso erleichterter ist sie, als Michael erklärt, dass Patrizias Zustand stabil ist und die Kinder wohlauf sind. Patrizia musste jedoch wegen der schweren Hirnverletzungen ins künstliche Koma versetzt werden.

Leonard reagiert getroffen auf Paulines Verdacht, er habe Patrizia die Treppe hinuntergestoßen. Während Pauline mit ihrem Gewissen hadert, wird sie von Friedrich unter Druck gesetzt, Leonards Drohung gegenüber Patrizia keinesfalls vor der Polizei zu erwähnen. Pauline erinnert sich an die Allianz zwischen Vater und Sohn, als beide Stahl-Männer sie durch ihre Lügen zu einer Zweckhochzeit mit Leonard drängen wollten. So verfestigt sich ihr Verdacht gegenüber Leonard immer weiter.

Friedrich wirft Pauline ungehalten vor, seinen Sohn ins Gefängnis gebracht zu haben. Pauline bereut, Leonard bei der Polizei angeschwärzt zu haben. Pauline gibt Martin einen Brief mit, in dem sie Leonard um Verzeihung bittet. Als Martin ihr den Brief ungelesen zurückgibt, erkennt Pauline, wie sehr Leonard von ihr enttäuscht ist. Charlotte hat inzwischen von Michael erfahren, dass Patrizia bereits am nächsten Tag aus dem künstlichen Koma geholt werden soll.

Friedrich bringt es nicht über sich, Patrizia zu töten, und wird um ein Haar von Barbara im Krankenzimmer ertappt. Obwohl er ungesehen verschwinden kann, bemerkt Barbara anhand von Fußspuren im verschütteten Blumenwasser, dass jemand in Patrizias Zimmer gewesen sein muss, und ihr Verdacht fällt auf Friedrich. Dieser leidet derweil unter der Gewissheit, dass Patrizia ihn entlarven wird, sobald sie am nächsten Tag aus dem künstlichen Koma erwacht ist.

Julia Klug will ihre Freundin Karla vom Flughafen abholen. Zufällig wird sie Zeugin, wie ein Dieb einer Stewardess einen Koffer entreißt. Julia will den Dieb stellen, der schleudert ihr den Koffer entgegen und entkommt. Beim Aufprall auf den Boden springt der Koffer auf - und eine Unmenge Zwei-Euro-Münzen purzelt auf den Boden, insgesamt mehrere Tausend Euro. Die bestohlene Stewardess ist spurlos verschwunden - maximal ein Fall für die Flughafenpolizei, meint Johannes Sonntag.

Beim morgendlichen Spaziergang mit Ellie an der Spree landet ihr Teddy im Wasser. Mit einem kühnen Sprung rettet Patrick das Stofftier. Doch im Wasser treiben auffallend viele tote Fische. Vorsichtshalber entnimmt Julia Klug eine Wasserprobe. Und Patrick beginnt, sich zu kratzen. Nur wenig später erstattet eine Mutter Anzeige auf der Wache: Ihr Sohn hat sich beim Spielen am Spreeufer eine Vergiftung zugezogen und liegt im Krankenhaus.

Durch einen Streich der Kollegen versteht Henri schon am ersten Arbeitstag, dass er in der Küchenhierarchie ganz unten steht. Am liebsten würde er alles wieder hinschmeißen. Als Volker ihn wieder aufbauen will, fühlt der sich von seinem übermenschlichen Bruder angegriffen. Volker soll seine Sachen packen und gehen. Henri will ihn hier nicht mehr sehen. Nora glaubt nicht an Carlas Vermutung, dass Lasse Interesse an ihr hat. Lasse hingegen freut sich insgeheim, dass Nora ihm erhalten bleibt.

Carla ist glücklich, ihre beste Jugendfreundin wiedergefunden zu haben. Auch Nora tut es gut, sie öffnet sich und erzählt von ihrer Tochter Edda. Doch die Gegenwart bleibt kompliziert, vor allem durch Torben. Er erfährt, dass es eine LKA-Akte über Nora Franke gibt und bringt Carla damit in einen Loyalitätskonflikt. Henri ist genervt von den guten Ratschlägen seines Bruders Volker und vom ewigen Kartoffelschälen im Job.

Der Tischlermeister Heiko Beck lebt seit dem Tod seiner Frau allein mit seinem Sohn Max. Sie haben ein sehr inniges Verhältnis. Während eines Besuches von Heikos Schwägerin Miriam Ellinger stürzt Max und bricht sich einen Knöchel. Dr. Stein und Dr. Heilmann operieren ihn und machen eine folgenschwere Entdeckung. Max leidet an Diabetes und braucht jetzt noch mehr Betreuung und Zuwendung.

Doktor Kaminski musste wegen zu schnellen Fahrens seinen Führerschein abgeben und muss wohl oder übel wieder Fahrstunden nehmen - zu seinem Leidwesen bei der resoluten, latent männerfeindlichen Uschi Kraft. In der Klinik stellt er fest, dass seine neue Patientin deren Tochter ist. Jana Kraft arbeitet ebenfalls als Fahrlehrerin und hatte einen unverschuldeten Autounfall.

Susanne wird von ihren Kindern mit dem Vorwurf konfrontiert, dass sie sich in der Trauerphase zu sehr mit sich selbst beschäftigt hat. Während ihr Sohn Jonas wieder auf Susanne zukommt, fühlt sich ihre Tochter Luisa nach wie vor alleingelassen.

Susannes Eltern bemerken, dass ihre Tochter nach dem dramatischen Sturz wieder zu sich selbst findet. Nach dem Unfall braucht Susanne dringend Unterstützung bei der Versorgung des Pferdes Caramel. Dr. Elif Sahin eilt ihr sofort zur Hilfe.

Als Johannes Sonntag seine neue Wohnung betreten will, muss er feststellen: Er ist auf einen Betrüger hereingefallen. Denn die Wohnung, die er vor einigen Tagen angemietet hat, ist bereits vergeben - und das seit Jahren. Eine Schmach für den Leiter des Betrugsdezernats, denn Johannes ermittelt schon seit einiger Zeit gegen die sogenannten "Mietmarder", eine Bande von gerissenen Mietbetrügern.

Razzia auf der Galopprennbahn Berlin-Hoppegarten - zeitgleich mit Polizeiaktionen auf Pferderennbahnen im gesamten Bundesgebiet sind Julia und Johannes im Einsatz, um Dopingbetrüger zur Strecke zu bringen. Nadja Bock, Chefin der Polizeidirektion 7, ist mächtig unter Druck. Undenkbar, sollte Berlin als einziger Ort ohne Ergebnis dastehen! Doch die Befürchtungen von Bock scheinen sich zu bestätigen. Sie finden nichts!

Kaum ist Ben aus New York zurück, kauft er sich einen alten Chopper, mietet Gunters Werkstattschuppen und geht nach einem heißen Flirt mit Simone ins Bett. Härter hätte er Nachbar Thomas nicht treffen können. Carla versucht vergeblich, Torben von Noras Spur abzubringen. Es fällt ihr schwer, ihn anzulügen, doch ihn einzuweihen ist auch unmöglich.

Lasse beweist sich als versierter Astrologie-Kenner, als er nur anhand von Noras Charaktereigenschaften ihr Sternzeichen errät. Leider ist es das ihrer wahren Identität. Als Torben eine Sternzeichen-Löwe-Kette bei Nora findet, obwohl sie offiziell im Mai geboren ist, wird er wieder misstrauisch. Ist Nora wirklich diejenige, die sie behauptet? Derweil ist Volker wie vom Blitz getroffen, als er Nora zum ersten Mal in Lüneburg begegnet.

Viktoria ist verärgert, da Felix Rosalies Schulden bei Evelyn tilgen will. Rosalie hört Viktorias Zweifeln und will sich in ein besseres Licht setzen. Ben findet es unmöglich, dass Rosalie auf Kosten ihrer Schwester lebt und sich ständig Geld leiht.

Viktoria lehnt Felix' Bitte ab und es kommt zu einem heftigen Streit. Emma macht Rosalie Vorwürfe, sich von ihr Geld unter Vorspiegelung falscher Tatsachen geliehen zu haben. Felix ist auch auf Werner sauer, weil dieser André wieder eingestellt hat.

Der Lehrer und Familienvater Mark Cobden muss eine vierjährige Haftstrafe antreten und schnell lernen, wie er im Gefängnis überlebt. Dabei hilft ihm der Wärter Eric McNally. Als ein Insasse dessen Schwachstelle entdeckt, gerät dieser in ein Dilemma.

Mark wird von dem gewalttätigen Insassen Johnno gemobbt. Soll er die Übergriffe melden und als Verräter gebrandmarkt werden, oder setzt er sich weiter den Aggressionen seines Peinigers aus? Unterdessen wird auch Erics Sohn angegriffen.

Mark setzt sich endlich gegen Johnno zur Wehr und unterstützt Daniel bei einem Treffen mit den Eltern seines Opfers. Eric und Daniel sind zunehmend auf die Hilfe von Jackson angewiesen, der für seinen Beistand jedoch immer höhere Preise aufruft.

Mark verpasst wegen Daniel die Beerdigung seines Vaters. Zum Ausgleich hält Marie-Louise im Gefängnis eine Messe für den Verstorbenen. Eric muss derweil immer größere Risiken eingehen, um seine Familie zu beschützen. Aber wo zieht er die Grenze?

Nachdem Frida Kahlo 1925 im Alter von 18 Jahren bei einem Busunfall schwer verletzt worden ist, beginnt sie wie besessen zu malen. Mit dem Pinsel therapiert sie im Bett ihre psychischen und physischen Schmerzen. Gerade auf dem Weg der Besserung lernt sie Diego Rivera kennen und bittet ihn, ehrlich ihr Talent einzuschätzen. Er ist begeistert von ihrem Können - und auch von ihrer Schönheit. Bald schon heiraten sie und werden zu einem der aufregendsten Paare des 20. Jahrhunderts.

Peru ist ein Land dramatischer Gegensätze: Obwohl tropische Regenwälder mehr als die Hälfte des Landes ausmachen, erstrecken sich im westlichen Teil im Schatten der Andenkette gewaltige Wüsten mit einer einzigartigen Tierwelt.

Die Reise geht in den Südosten Perus, wo sich die Region Madre de Dios erstreckt, die nach dem gleichnamigen Fluss benannt ist. Der tropische Regenwald beherbergt eine riesige, auf der Welt einzigartige Vielfalt an Pflanzen- und Tierarten.

Schnabeltiere, Dingos oder Tasmanische Teufel - in Australiens weiten Wäldern leben Tiere, die es nur dort gibt, nirgendwo sonst. Ihre außergewöhnliche Anpassungsfähigkeit ermöglicht ihnen ein Überleben in dieser oftmals feindlichen Natur.

Tierfilmer Rainer Bergomaz und sein indianischer Kollege Yung Sandy begeben sich auf eine Expedition in eines der letzten unerschlossenen Gebiete der Erde, um den Mohrenkaiman zu finden. Bisher weiß man kaum etwas über den großen Bruder des Alligators und das größte Krokodil Südamerikas. Wie alle großen Echsen wurde auch der Mohrenkaiman über Jahrhunderte hinweg erbarmungslos gejagt. So ist seine Art inzwischen stark gefährdet.

Rainer Bergomaz und Yung Sandy überwinden Stromschnellen, Flüsse und Wasserfälle, klettern auf 50 Meter hohe Bäume, kämpfen sich durch Buschwerk und Lianen, um ein Harpyien-Nest zu finden. Harpyien zählen zu den mächtigsten Greifvögeln der Welt. Die seltenen Adler leben in den Regenwäldern Südamerikas. Der Griff ihrer Klauen ist kräftiger als der Biss eines Schäferhundes, ihre Krallen sind länger als die des Grizzlybären.

Weltweit hören wir derzeit vor allem negative Schlagzeilen rund um Urwald-Abholzung und Umwelt-Zerstörung. Doch es gibt auch Hoffnung. Im Norden Argentiniens werden die ersten Jaguare eines besonderen Schutzprojekts ausgewildert.

pr.t: Say Yes to the Dress Lancashire
pr.d: Showtime Or Showdown. Mackenna has her heart set on a floaty boho-dress, but mum has different ideas! Plus, Laura is out of her comfort zone when she's trying on dresses. S2, Ep9
Alice Ruggles. After Alice Ruggles ends their romantic relationship, her ex-boyfriend Harry Dhillon's refusal to let go turns sinister. S4, Ep6

pr.t: On the Case with Paula Zahn
pr.d: The Year Of Fear. When a college student is found murdered, police suspect the killer is someone she knew. The investigation threatens to tear her family apart. S12, Ep20
Stalking Cynthia. Fifty-seven-year-old Cynthia Langrall is a devoted wife and hardworking paralegal. So when she's shot dead, police are baffled as to who would commit the crime. S4, Ep3
Robert Maudsley. Relatives of serial killer Robert Maudsley reveal how his shocking crimes impacted the family. Were there any signs of his murderous intentions? S2, Ep2
Second Chance. A Utah family is torn apart after a disgruntled ex-husband, unable to move on, comes looking for revenge on his former wife after she gets remarried. S6, Ep1
Unmasked. In Knoxville, Tennessee, a seemingly perfect couple were secretly living a nightmare. The wife was found guilty of soliciting her new partner to kill her former husband. S6, Ep3
Tape The Scene. An 82-year-old woman is found murdered in her garage in Wisconsin. A city-wide manhunt follows, and investigators are forced to curb public hysteria. S2, Ep3
Arash Ghorbani-Zarin. Judge Rinder explores a shocking stabbing as a result of an 'honour killing'. Plus, the tragic story of a four-year-old who was a hit-and-run victim. S4, Ep7
Rideshare Nightmare. In 2019, after a night out with friends, student Samantha Josephson climbs into a car she mistakes for her rideshare, never to be seen alive again. S8, Ep9
Someone To Watch Over Her. On a cold winter night, a mother doesn't return home from work. As dawn breaks, her body is found in a churchyard. Will CCTV footage reveal the killer? S2, Ep13

pr.t: Michael Jackson: A Faking It Special
pr.d: Michael Jackson faced serious allegations for years. Using interview footage and televised statements, experts closely analyse his behaviours.

Victoria survives a horrific crash, wins a large settlement and then dies after an explosion.

O programa é formatado para ser uma revista eletrônica de informação e entretenimento para os telespectadores aos domingos. Seu principal diferencial é oferecer uma opção inteligente no horário dos tradicionais programas de auditório.Uma conceituada equipe de profissionais trabalha durante toda a semana para apresentar, no domingo, um jornalismo ágil e moderno, com reportagens de denúncia, comportamento, ciência, turismo, medicina e aventura, além de um panorama geral dos fatos que marcaram a semana. O esporte também tem o seu espaço garantido e é pauta constante das matérias do programa. Os repórteres viajam pelo país e também para o exterior em busca da informação que interessa aos brasile

O reality show mostra um lado desconhecido dos participantes, que são testados em tarefas típicas do meio rural. Esses novos caipiras, que antes só faziam esforço físico na malhação da academia, têm que acordar com as galinhas, enfrentar o trabalho na roça e ainda provar que são inteligentes e fortes o bastante para aguentar as armadilhas de um confinamento.
